building-change.title: Multi-temporal building change detection
building-change.summary: Deep learning change detection system identifying building extensions, new constructions, and demolitions from multi-year orthophotos.

blocks.heading: My contribution
blocks.body: At HawarIT Limited, I developed and deployed an automated multi-temporal change detection system using deep learning to identify building extensions, new constructions, and demolitions from multi-year orthophoto surveys.

blocks.heading: Deep Learning Architecture
blocks.body: Designed convolutional neural network pipelines trained on multi-temporal, high-resolution aerial imagery to distinguish actual structural changes from seasonal variations, differing illumination, and sensor viewpoints.

blocks.heading: GIS Web Platform Integration
blocks.body: Integrated the automated detection pipeline into an interactive GIS-based web validation platform for cartographic reviewers.

blocks.heading: Quantitative Results
blocks.body: Achieved **88% detection accuracy** across varied urban landscapes, reducing manual inspection and verification efforts by **65%**.

eeg-research.title: Locomotive features in EEG of impaired consciousness
eeg-research.summary: Undergraduate thesis at IUT on analyzing EEG time-series signals and distinctive cerebral rhythms in impaired consciousness (coma).

blocks.heading: Academic context
blocks.body:
My undergraduate B.Sc. thesis in Electrical and Electronic Engineering at the Islamic University of Technology (IUT) investigated:

**"Quantifying Locomotive Features in EEG of Impaired Consciousness (Coma) with Distinctive Cerebral Rhythms"**

blocks.heading: Signal Analysis
blocks.body: Analyzed clinical EEG time-series signals to identify discriminative spectral and temporal features characterizing depths of consciousness and coma states.

blocks.heading: Rhythm Decomposition
blocks.body: Extracted distinctive cerebral rhythms across patient recordings, developing algorithmic criteria to evaluate rhythmic variability and state transitions.

blocks.heading: Academic Distinction
blocks.body: Evaluated under both Project and Thesis courses at IUT, receiving the highest grade of **A+** for research rigor.

gis-digitization.title: Large-scale 3D CityGML modeling and texture projection
gis-digitization.summary: Automated pipeline for 3D CityGML reconstruction and photorealistic texture generation from high-resolution aerial imagery.

blocks.heading: My contribution
blocks.body: At HawarIT Limited, I built an automated pipeline for large-scale 3D CityGML reconstruction and photorealistic texture generation from high-resolution aerial surveys.

blocks.heading: Automated 3D Reconstruction
blocks.body: Developed algorithms converting 2D footprint geometries and elevation models into semantic 3D CityGML building representations at scale.

blocks.heading: Occlusion-Aware Multi-View Texture Projection
blocks.body: Designed custom texture projection algorithms that dynamically evaluate viewing angles, occlusions, and image resolution to project aerial imagery onto 3D building facades.

blocks.heading: Quantitative Results
blocks.body: Maintained strict geometric alignment with a **texture shift of less than 3 pixels**, generating high-fidelity photorealistic urban digital twin models for municipal planning.

orthophoto-production.title: Orthophoto production, pose estimation, and AI QA
orthophoto-production.summary: Automated orthophoto production with AI image quality assessment (97%), PostGIS/AHN seamline optimization, and 2-pixel camera pose estimation.

blocks.heading: My contribution
blocks.body: At HawarIT Limited, I architected and implemented AI-based automation tools across the photogrammetric orthophoto production lifecycle, eliminating critical manual bottlenecks in image filtering, triangulation, and seamline generation.

blocks.heading: AI-Based Image Quality Assessment (QA)
blocks.body: Developed deep learning models to detect cloud, shadow, and blur artifacts on raw aerial imagery prior to aerial triangulation (AT), achieving **97% QA accuracy**.

blocks.heading: Automated Camera Pose Estimation
blocks.body: Engineered a feature-matching and tie-point generation framework to register incoming flight images against historical reference orthophotos. Attained **2-pixel alignment accuracy**, cutting manual aerial triangulation effort by **90%**.

blocks.heading: Seamline Refinement via PostGIS & AHN LiDAR
blocks.body: Automated seamline placement and geometric validation using PostgreSQL/PostGIS paired with AHN airborne LiDAR elevation data, cutting manual seamline editing by **65%**.

point-cloud-processing.title: 3D point cloud intelligence and BIM extraction
point-cloud-processing.summary: AI-driven semantic segmentation and BIM model extraction from aerial, mobile, and indoor LiDAR datasets.

blocks.heading: My contribution
blocks.body: At HawarIT Limited, I led the development of point cloud intelligence algorithms for semantic segmentation and automated Building Information Modeling (BIM) extraction from large-scale LiDAR datasets.

blocks.heading: Multi-Source LiDAR Processing
blocks.body: Built processing pipelines handling dense 3D point clouds across diverse acquisition platforms: aerial surveys, mobile vehicle-mounted mapping systems, and high-precision indoor laser scanners.

blocks.heading: Automated Pipe & Geometry Extraction
blocks.body: Implemented custom algorithms to detect industrial and building piping networks, segment structural components, and extract geometric properties directly from unstructured 3D point data.

blocks.heading: Quantitative Results
blocks.body: Achieved **95% extraction accuracy** while cutting manual 3D modeling and processing time by **60%**.

remote-sensing.title: Multispectral earth observation and remote sensing AI
remote-sensing.summary: AI solutions using Sentinel satellite imagery for crop classification, water quality analysis, and algae bloom detection (2nd place, international tender).

blocks.heading: My contribution
blocks.body: Deployed AI solutions leveraging European Space Agency (ESA) Sentinel multispectral satellite imagery for large-scale Earth observation, environmental monitoring, and natural resource management.

blocks.heading: Multispectral Analytics
blocks.body: Engineered computer vision pipelines operating across Sentinel-2 optical and infrared spectral bands to analyze vegetative indices, crop phenology, and surface water dynamics.

blocks.heading: Environmental Monitoring
blocks.body: Built multi-class deep learning models for automated crop type classification, water body delineation, and harmful algae bloom detection across aquatic ecosystems.

blocks.heading: International Recognition
blocks.body:
This Earth observation analytics framework secured **2nd place in an international innovation tender**.

In addition to satellite remote sensing, my open-source computer vision contributions include a multi-label vehicle and traffic detection framework:

- [Multi-Label Vehicle Detection Repository](https://github.com/fahome10bd/Multi-Label-Vehicle-detection-based-on-AI) (comparisons of YOLOv3, YOLOv5, and R-CNN architectures across 21 traffic classes).

traffic-sign-inspection.title: Street-view GeoAI and asset localization
traffic-sign-inspection.summary: End-to-end GeoAI pipeline for detection and geospatial localization of 130 traffic sign and 33 street furniture classes from 360° street imagery.

blocks.heading: My contribution
blocks.body: At HawarIT Limited, I engineered a comprehensive end-to-end GeoAI system for automated detection, classification, and geospatial localization of road and roadside infrastructure from car-mounted 360° street-view imagery.

blocks.heading: Asset Detection & Recognition
blocks.body: Trained and optimized custom YOLOv5 models capable of recognizing **130 distinct traffic sign categories** and **33 street furniture classes** under varying lighting, weather, and occlusions.

blocks.heading: Geospatial Localization & Tracking
blocks.body: Implemented custom multi-object tracking and triangulation algorithms to compute high-precision world coordinates for detected assets directly from vehicle GPS and camera trajectory telemetry.

blocks.heading: Quantitative Results
blocks.body: Delivered **>95% object detection accuracy** and **92% geospatial localization precision**, transforming raw street video logs into structured, GIS-ready asset inventories.
